snippet.title: CastleVille trailer
snippet.description: Soon, you'll be able to build your very own fair kingdom in CastleVille. Get a sneak peek at the trailer below and 'like' us to find out first when the game is here. From Zynga, the makers of FarmVille and CityVille.
